description: Remind about version policy when creating a shipping branch; never mutate files.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, runpy, subprocess; runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip()) / '.codex/hooks/branch_version_hook.py'), run_name='__main__')"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import pathlib, runpy, subprocess; runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip()) / '.codex/hooks/branch_version_hook.py'), run_name='__main__')"
